title: anaphalis bulleyana
intro: Anaphalis bulleyana, commonly known as Bulley's anaphalis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of China and India. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease.
